name: Huécija (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of purple, yellow and green with a yellow middle stripe of double width, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Huécija (a castle, a tower and a lion on purple and green).
history: The municipal flag of Huécija is a rectangular cloth of 2:3 divided into three horizontal stripes, purple above, gold yellow at the centre and green below, the yellow stripe twice the width of the others; the colours are taken from the most prominent tinctures of the arms.

features.role: Huécija arms — castle, tower and lion
